description: Tailwind CSS v4's scanner, loaded by @tailwindcss/node and @tailwindcss/vite. The npm tarball ships no Rust source, so the git route takes the tailwindcss monorepo at the v<version> tag and cross-checks it against the release's npm provenance attestation (the packument carries no gitHead). Upstream's release line for this binding is crates/node's build:platform, napi build --platform --release, with no features. The one cdylib, tailwind-oxide, stands in for @tailwindcss/oxide-linux-x64-{gnu,musl}. Profile: upstream's wasm build (build:wasm, napi build --release --target wasm32-wasip1-threads) is panic=abort, its wasm32 target's strategy, and ships no name section (napi's post-link drops it), so the recipe sets panic abort and strip symbols; no #[napi] function here opts into catch_unwind, so a panic already aborts at the extern "C" boundary under unwind.
